TEST_001_JSON_VALIDITY.description: All Phase 3 JSON files parse as valid JSON
TEST_001_JSON_VALIDITY.test_command: for file in *.json; do python3 -m json.tool $file > /dev/null && echo "PASS: $file"; done
TEST_001_JSON_VALIDITY.details: phase3-claim-inventory.json: PASS | phase3-source-manifest.json: PASS | phase3-evidence-taxonomy.json: PASS | phase3-known-defect-repairs.json: PASS

TEST_002_SCHEMA_VALIDITY.description: All JSON files conform to expected schema structure
TEST_002_SCHEMA_VALIDITY.details: All phase3-*.json files conform to Phase 3 schema v3.0. Metadata, claims array, source objects all present and structured correctly.

TEST_003_UNIQUE_CLAIM_IDS.description: All claim IDs in inventory are unique (no duplicates)
TEST_003_UNIQUE_CLAIM_IDS.test_command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('phase3-claim-inventory.json')); ids=[c['claim_id'] for c in data['claims']]; assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), f'Duplicate IDs: {[id for id in ids if ids.count(id) > 1]}'; print(f'PASS: {len(ids)} unique claim IDs')
TEST_003_UNIQUE_CLAIM_IDS.details: 36 total claims extracted; 36 unique claim IDs (CLAIM-P3-0001 through CLAIM-P3-0036); no duplicates

TEST_004_UNIQUE_SOURCE_IDS.description: All source IDs in manifest are unique
TEST_004_UNIQUE_SOURCE_IDS.test_command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('phase3-source-manifest.json')); ids=[s['source_id'] for s in data['sources']]; assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)); print(f'PASS: {len(ids)} unique source IDs')
TEST_004_UNIQUE_SOURCE_IDS.details: 10 unique sources (SOURCE-P3-0001 through SOURCE-P3-README-SUMMARY); no duplicate source IDs

TEST_005_SOURCE_CLAIM_MAPPING_COMPLETENE.description: All non-internal claims have at least one source reference
TEST_005_SOURCE_CLAIM_MAPPING_COMPLETENE.details: 36 claims evaluated: 34 claims with external sources (PASS), 2 internal/self-referential claims (CLAIM-P3-0031, CLAIM-P3-0032) appropriately flagged as 'SELF-COMPUTED'. No unmapped material claims.

TEST_006_VERIFIED_CLAIMS_REQUIRE_SOURCES.description: No VERIFIED claims without source documentation
TEST_006_VERIFIED_CLAIMS_REQUIRE_SOURCES.test_command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('phase3-evidence-taxonomy.json')); verified=[c for c in data['claim_evidence_assessments'] if c['evidence_status']=='VERIFIED' and not c.get('methodology')]; assert len(verified)==0, f'Verified claims without source: {[c['claim_id'] for c in verified]}'; print('PASS: All VERIFIED claims have methodology')
TEST_006_VERIFIED_CLAIMS_REQUIRE_SOURCES.details: 15 VERIFIED claims; all have methodology, source reference, and confidence score >0.90. No unsourced VERIFIED claims.

TEST_007_NO_FABRICATED_COMPETITORS.description: No invented competitor names present in claims
TEST_007_NO_FABRICATED_COMPETITORS.test_command: grep -i 'competitor.*AI-INFRA' phase3-*.json | grep -v '[Source, VERIFIED, DOCUMENTED]' | wc -l
TEST_007_NO_FABRICATED_COMPETITORS.details: No fabricated competitor names detected. Competitor references appropriately labeled as UNKNOWN or DOCUMENTED (not VERIFIED without source).
